policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Haitian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Haitian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's table says a visa can be obtained on arrival for a total of 40 JOD.

Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code. Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy schedule lists Haiti in the authorized-visa cohort, which requires approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Haitian passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the schedule's Haiti visa-free exception is expressly limited to diplomatic passports.
The authorized-visa instructions require a personal consular appearance and state that approval may take up to 60 business days. This is advance visa processing, not electronic or arrival issuance.
The cited embassy's application-document list is jurisdiction-specific. Other consular post procedures, purpose, fees, supporting documents and final admission remain outside this baseline.

policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry expressly requires a visa for Haitian ordinary passport holders.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Haitian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The current Foreign Ministry nationality schedule expressly requires a visa; it does not state a Haitian ordinary-passport visa-on-arrival route.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, any future electronic route and final admission remain outside this policy.

conflicts.explanation: The full suspension retains valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers, so it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The full suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes Puerto Rico. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
